resources.string: Android Auto only. Test while parked, using the same theme and route. These options ask the phone to lay out its map differently; they do not remove Google’s card or change the car’s own indicators. Baseline restores the existing map configuration.
Saved for the next Android Auto connection. Return home and tap Restart, or disconnect and reconnect. The current session keeps its negotiated map.

Advertise support for 128 × 128 arrow images instead of codes only. This tests which guidance messages the phone sends; it does not promise timing data. Applies after reconnecting Android Auto. Leave off for the map tests first.

Includes message types, field presence and received timing values in diagnostic logs. Does not add road names, destination text, coordinates or image contents to these test logs. Save a diagnostic report after each test.

string-array.name: aa_gwm_map_test_modes
string-array.item: Stock reserved areas — current stream and DPI

resources.string: Which Android Auto protocol version Di-Connect asks for. From 1.6 the phone may send richer guidance, including arrival time; 4.3 also lets it read display flags. Other phone behaviour may change too. Applies after reconnecting. Baseline restores the current version.

string-array.name: aa_gwm_nav_protocol_modes
string-array.item: Richer guidance and display flags — protocol 4.3

resources.string: Tell the phone the car shows the turn card (experimental)

Needs protocol 4.3. Asks Android Auto not to draw its own turn card on the cluster. Google Maps may or may not follow it, so turn on Di-Connect directions on the Themes screen. Applies after reconnecting.
Sends the instrument-cluster-available message (0x8001) when the navigation channel opens. Unproven. Applies after reconnecting.
